//: Cierra WFS y prueba GetMap de la capa de cables sobre un bbox chico.
//ojo: Solo estados, tipos y bytes. Ningun dato de red.

steps.eval: const findNode = (rx) => [...document.querySelectorAll('.x-tree-node-text')].find((el) => rx.test(el.textContent.trim())); const apps = findNode(/^aplicaciones$/i); if (apps) { let c = apps; for (let i = 0; i < 6 && c; i += 1) { if (c.querySelector && c.querySelector('.x-tree-expander')) break; c = c.parentElement; } const ex = c ? c.querySelector('.x-tree-expander') : null; (ex || apps).click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)); } const mapa = findNode(/^mapas?$/i); if (!mapa) return { error: 'no Mapas' }; mapa.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 9000)); return { ready: true };

const w = document.querySelector('#content').contentWindow; const ol = w.ol; const req = (params, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => { let done = false; const finish = (v) => { if (!done) { done = true; resolve(v); } }; const timer = setTimeout(() => finish({ ok: false, e: 'timeout' }), ms || 12000); const fail = (e) => { clearTimeout(timer); finish({ ok: false, e: String((e && e.message) || e) }); }; try { w.Acs.request({ url: 'svc_wmc.php', params, success: (r) => { clearTimeout(timer); finish({ ok: true, r }); }, failure: fail }); } catch (err) { fail(err); } }); const get = async (url, ms) => { const c = new AbortController(); const t = setTimeout(() => c.abort(), ms || 15000); try { const r = await w.fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin', signal: c.signal }); const buf = await r.arrayBuffer(); const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf); return { status: r.status, ct: (r.headers.get('content-type') || '').slice(0, 40), len: bytes.length, magic: bytes.length > 8 ? String.fromCharCode(bytes[0], bytes[1], bytes[2], bytes[3]) : null, text: (r.headers.get('content-type') || '').indexOf('image') === 0 ? null : new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.slice(0, 600)) }; } catch (e) { return { status: 0, error: String(e.message).slice(0, 80) }; } finally { clearTimeout(t); } }; const out = {}; const wfs = await get('/webmap/saesa/service?SERVICE=WFS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities&VERSION=1.1.0', 12000); out.wfs = { status: wfs.status, ct: wfs.ct, len: wfs.len, cuerpo: wfs.text ? wfs.text.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 260) : null }; const vp = w.webMap_.getViewportParams ? w.webMap_.getViewportParams() : {}; const s = await req(Object.assign({ action: 'textual_search', query: 'F913184', page: 1, start: 0, limit: 25 }, vp)); const rows = (s.ok && (Array.isArray(s.r) ? s.r : (s.r.rows || s.r.data))) || []; const ids = rows.map((x) => x.object_id).filter(Boolean); const gj = await req(Object.assign({ action: 'get_objects_geojson', object_ids: w.Ext.encode(ids) }, vp)); const norm = (r) => (r && r.type === 'Feature' ? [r] : (r && r.features) || []); const feats = norm(gj.r); if (!feats.length) return Object.assign(out, { error: 'sin punto base' }); const lon = feats[0].geometry.coordinates[0]; const lat = feats[0].geometry.coordinates[1]; const c = ol.proj.fromLonLat([lon, lat]); const half = 300; const bbox = [c[0] - half, c[1] - half, c[0] + half, c[1] + half]; out.bboxMetros = half * 2; const getMap = async (layer, size) => { const q = new URLSearchParams({ SERVICE: 'WMS', VERSION: '1.1.1', REQUEST: 'GetMap', LAYERS: layer, STYLES: '', SRS: 'EPSG:3857', BBOX: bbox.join(','), WIDTH: String(size), HEIGHT: String(size), FORMAT: 'image/png', TRANSPARENT: 'TRUE' }); return await get('/webmap/saesa/service?' + q.toString(), 15000); }; out.faseCables = await getMap('saesa.webmap.fase_cables_mt', 800); out.mediumVoltage = await getMap('webmap.distribution.medium_voltage', 800); out.tensionCables = await getMap('saesa.webmap.tension_cables_mt', 800); return out;
